encounter.text: Something is standing in the passage ahead, doing what you're doing a half-second after you do it. When you stop, it stops. When you tilt your head, it tilts its head. It has your height, your shape, your posture — but its fur is the wrong colour and its eyes catch no light at all. It waits.

spoken.text: It says your last word back at you. Then the word before that. Then one from much earlier — something you said days ago, to someone who isn't here. You don't know how it knows. After a moment, it becomes apparent it intends to work backwards through everything you've ever said. You'll need to decide how you feel about that.

choices.text: Attack it before it goes further.

items.name: Reflected Strike
items.description: Returns damage with the weight of everything you've done.

followed.text: It leads you through several passages that you're fairly sure weren't there before. Eventually it stops at a section of wall that is not entirely solid and looks at you over its shoulder with your own face. There's something on the ground — coins, but cold in a way that lasts. It walks into the wall and is gone.
